items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met him, you know I talked with – he liked my work, and I liked his work.

ctx.x: And how about Hale Smith? Talk about…

Hale Smith – well Hale – I met him, you know I talked with – he liked my work, and I liked his work. He had done some work with Eric Dolphy, Eric Dolphy introduced me to Hale, Mr. Hale Smith. He just died, huh.
